CategoryPresetCreate.title: CategoryPresetCreate
CategoryPresetCreate.description: New expenses whose description contains `keyword` get `category_id`.

ExpenseUpdate.title: ExpenseUpdate
ExpenseUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent change. Sending `split` or `participants` re-splits the expense
with today's rules and members; any other edit keeps its participants and inputs.

InvitationRead.title: InvitationRead
InvitationRead.description: The group's join code (one per group, valid 7 days), typed by hand by the invitee.

NotificationPrefs.title: NotificationPrefs
NotificationPrefs.description: In-app switches. `enabled` is the master switch; the rest are per event type.

NotificationPrefsUpdate.title: NotificationPrefsUpdate
NotificationPrefsUpdate.description: Partial update: only the fields sent change.

SummaryRead.title: SummaryRead
SummaryRead.description:
Totals of the live expenses matching the list filters.

By default full amounts of shared (non-personal) expenses; with `mine=true` only the
caller's share of each expense they take part in, personal expenses included.
